curriculum.construction: the same 12-transaction template is instantiated independently for each base Cell; transaction matrices are deterministic from formal seed

intent.collision: requested residual lies only in the already protected base span and is therefore mathematically infeasible without growth
intent.free: new residual lies in currently unused feature directions
intent.near: new residual is expressed by a weak remaining free direction
intent.reuse: a previously spawned child sees a new direction outside its own Q

decision_question: Can bounded Cell-local subspace state replace historical replay for deciding safe writes and saturation-triggered mitosis in a controlled continual-learning system?

gates.rule: all gates must pass independently on all three formal seeds; no majority rescue or post-hoc threshold changes

positive_does_not_establish: that arbitrary nonlinear Transformer parameters admit a fixed sufficient subspace certificate
that hidden-state activation spans stay low-rank at language-model scale
that natural-language semantic routing provides exact dependency domains
that an opaque pretrained checkpoint can reconstruct missing certificates
that all semantic knowledge is preserved beyond the registered functional subspace
positive_supports: for linear-writable Cells with frozen feature coordinates and stable explicit routing, a finite Cell-local activation-subspace certificate can replace raw historical replay for exact registered-history write protection
safe-write feasibility can be computed from current data plus Q
infeasibility can act as a saturation signal
monotonic private-Cell growth can restore plasticity while remaining reusable and bounded in the registered synthetic curriculum

mechanism.cell_form: y = W z with frozen feature coordinates during continual learning
mechanism.certificate: Q is an orthonormal basis spanning committed activation rows for the Cell
mechanism.child_reuse: later writes for an address with a private Cell update only the private Cell; base Q still records every committed activation because base output remains on-path
mechanism.feasibility: solve min_A ||Z P_free A - R||_F^2; direct write is feasible iff normalized residual <= threshold
mechanism.mitosis: on infeasible first-address direct write, attach a zero-output exact-address private Cell and retry with empty Q
mechanism.wrong_certificate_control: row-roll Q by one feature coordinate, preserving rank/norm but corrupting geometry

world.private_growth_route: exact address only, monotonic addition, zero-output initialization
